name: codex-claude-fable-plugin
description: Call Claude models from Codex chat with a word-based model picker, effort selection, and per-project conversation memory.

interface.shortDescription: Call Claude models from Codex chat.
interface.longDescription: Claude for Codex routes chat turns to the local Claude Code CLI: pick a model with a word ($claude opus ...), set effort the same way, keep a per-project conversation going across calls, and opt into read-only repo access with the repo keyword. Uses your existing Claude CLI login — no API key.
defaultPrompt: $claude repo what does this codebase do?
